status: Documented integration baseline; not automatically applied to existing assets or current Gallery viewer
goal: Preserve material character across projects, not reproduce thumbnail camera or fixed studio lighting
authoritative_asset_input: Each GLB material and supported extensions; never replace all assets with one material

common_runtime.lighting_space: Linear-sRGB or an explicitly managed equivalent
common_runtime.numeric_base_color_factor_encoding: Linear; do not apply a second sRGB conversion to glTF factors
common_runtime.display_transform_reference: AgX where supported, compare corresponding implementation/look; not guaranteed pixel-identical to Blender
common_runtime.exposure_values_are: Suggested integration starting points, not an audit claim that every historic thumbnail used these exact values
common_runtime.postprocessing: Avoid extra saturation/contrast or duplicate tone mapping until baseline matches
common_runtime.environment: Use project-appropriate diffuse light and reflection environment. Neutral environment for material comparison; no fixed light positions or camera required.
common_runtime.contact_shadow_or_ao: Recommended for comparable depth, not embedded by default and not a substitute for material values

not_required_to_copy: Cycles sample count in a real-time engine
limitations: Lighting still changes perceived roughness, highlights and metal reflections
Renderer BRDF, shadows, indirect light and display transform can differ
Generic Blender nodes not represented in GLB do not automatically transfer
No guarantee of identical appearance in arbitrary lighting or unsupported renderers

observed_thumbnail_common_subset.sample_scope: Six representative current generator sources plus the old sample batch; not full library
observed_thumbnail_common_subset.area_lighting: Several distinct three-area-light presets were observed; not one identical universal lighting configuration
observed_thumbnail_common_subset.native_save_order: Some early scripts save source.blend before adding the thumbnail lights/camera; regenerate preview scene from generate.py if exact authoring setup is needed

gallery_observation.note: Observed code before this documentation commit; this change does not alter the viewer.
